seo.title: About Kraqen Innovations | Kraqen

intro.title: WE ENGINEER VISUAL CULTURE.
intro.paragraph: We bridge the gap between high-end cinematography and scroll-stopping social engagement. Whether we are shooting a high-octane motorsport campaign or launching a cult-status brand, we don't just capture content, we build narratives engineered to dominate the feed.

members.name: VICTOR YUEN
members.bio: Victor has worked in the creative industry for more than a decade, collaborating with clients at every scale. With a background in design, he puts storytelling and strong visual direction at the forefront of every project.
members.alt: Victor Yuen, Founder and Creative Director at Kraqen Innovations

members.name: MAX TAGESEN
members.bio: Max is a multidisciplinary creator with an undying passion for sport. He tells real, meaningful stories through photography and video, looking for the emotion and movement that make each frame unique.
members.alt: Max Tagesen, Editor and Camera Operator at Kraqen Innovations
